user.title: ADS-B Live
user.description: Adds your own ADS-B receiver, readsb or tar1090 on your network, with sensors for its health such as messages per second and range. To see the aircraft on a map, add an aircraft feed separately from the integration page.

data_description.name: The receiver's name. The sensors are named after the receiver.
data_description.url: The address of tar1090, or of readsb's own web server.
data_description.language: Language in which the feed's information, such as an aircraft's details, is shown on the map.
data_description.altitude_unit: Altitudes in metres and vertical rates in m/s, or feet and ft/min.

data_description.url: The address of tar1090, or of readsb's own web server.
data_description.language: Language in which the feed's information, such as an aircraft's details, is shown on the map.
data_description.altitude_unit: Altitudes in metres and vertical rates in m/s, or feet and ft/min.

error.cannot_connect: The receiver couldn't be reached at the given address. Check that the path data/receiver.json can be opened under it.

abort.already_configured: This receiver is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This receiver is already being set up.

user.title: Aircraft feed
user.description: Choose the area whose aircraft are added to the feed's sensor. An aircraft is in the feed while its position is less than a minute old.

data_description.name: The feed's name. The sensor is named after the feed.
data_description.adsb_fi: Aircraft your receiver doesn't hear, from adsb.fi's community network. The data fetched is for personal, non-commercial use only. With it, the area's radius can be at most 461 km.
data_description.trail_minutes: Each aircraft's trail on the map shows its route over the set number of minutes. 0 leaves trails out.
data_description.color_by_altitude: Each aircraft and its trail in the colour of its altitude, on the scale tar1090 uses, with a legend on the map.
